reviews.x: I wanted to try some alternatives to Jamberry, found these randomly and decided to try them. I am extremely happy that I did!! These were so much easier for me to apply then Jamberry. Since there's some stretch to them, I was able to pull out wrinkles really easily. I thought they held up better than Jamberry too. I will definitely be buying more of these.

reviews.t: Galaxy Nails for my Star Trek Fetish!
reviews.x: These are better quality nail stickers than I've used before.  I don't use them often because I just don't normally have good luck with them.  They tend to peel and are gone in a few hours.  These come in different sizes and are STRETCHABLE so you can  get a tad extra width or length without having to go up to the next size and wasting a whole one. I like that!  What I did after I applied them was to put rhinestones and then clear gel polish to help with any peeling.  So far so good. :) ***If yo

I was pleasantly surprised by these nail wraps. I've never used nail wraps before and I don't paint my nails often nor do I actually take care of my nails. I have no idea why I bought these to be honest. I think I just liked the thought of having little star clusters on my fingers. Anyway, they were very easy to put on. I even messed up a few things and I was able to reposition them correctly. They took way longer to put on than I excepted but I was also being extremely picky and it was my first
Super easy to use. Had no trouble getting these on. Wish they lasted a bit longer, but I neglected to put a top coat on, so perhaps it will be better next time. Really dig the great designs!
Arrived later than expected, but overall pleased with product.

My first set of nail polish decals/stickers came in a monthly beauty box and I liked them - a lot. When I received a coupon for a deep discount on a different website I jumped at the chance and then set out binge shopping for nail decals. THESE caught my eye and I ordered them as well - turns out they were much easier to apply then the "expensive" brand and have lasted longer too! These stickers are beautiful!  They do look fantastic on your nails!  However the term sticker is really applicable.  I had a lot of difficulty attaching them to my nails primarily because I don't grow mine out very long so I had to do a lot of cutting to get them to fit.  It is rather unwieldy if you have short nails.  I didn't deduct any stars for that though because that's a personal preference. My twin got this for christmas and seemed to like it a lot

reviews.t: Awesome design,  heart value.  Smart buy!!
reviews.x: These are more like wraps them stickers which is nice.  They aren't as thick as some nail stickers that I've used, which had its ups and downs. The good part is they stretch which allows you to get a good fit on the ends of your nails where as with other brands I've had trouble with wrinkles and bubbling. The down side is they tend to not last as long as thicker brands. I can usually get a week of wear out of them, and this is with constant hand washing. With these, I was able to wear them for a

These are nice for short term use but they didn't last very long for me. The colors are great and they are very pretty but, unless you have really long nails, there is a lot of waste since you can only apply from one side (so for me over half of each sticker went in the trash). They are fairly easy to apply compared to other brands that I have tried and it was nice to not need to heat them up. I wish there were a few more sizes included as I had to trim them for width to fit my nails but for the

I just received these and am very happy!  The designs are beautiful and don't look cheap and pixelated like so many of the drugstore brands.  I haven't put them on yet, I'm waiting for a set of fake nails to arrive to see if they will stick on those.  My plan is to put the designs on press on nails so I can wear them over and over, and if it starts to chip or peel, I will just use the good ones as accent nails.  I will update with how this goes.  This comes with 3 packs with 14 stickers in each

reviews.t: Great alternative to the salon & pricey nail wraps
reviews.x: I love to have pretty nails but we are constantly doing some kind of project around our home.  I generally don't have time to go to get my nails done because with 4 kids and a hubby that works crazy hours it's hard to schedule.  I've been very fond of the Jamberry brand but unless I put a clear gel top coat on my nails look awful after a day or two. Also these don't need a heater or blow dryer to apply.  I really like all the designs in this package and that it took no special heater or tools to

reviews.t: Easy to put on, but didn't last.
reviews.x: I desperately want to like these, but for me, they didn't even last a day. I put em on in the afternoon & when I woke up the next morning, several of them had folded over at the edges. I'm guessing it must have to do w/ how I sleep, but I wouldnt have imagined they'd do that! They were really easy to put on (& take off) though. And even though this one time they didn't last long, I still liked them better than the jamberry wraps. I end up w/ too many wrinkles w/ the jamberry ones. My fingernails

It was exactly as I expected. I wish it was three sets of stars. I really don't like the gray at all. The packaging was very nice and neat. It has a strong oder when it's first opened, but it fades away after a couple of minutes, much like regular nail polish.  The wraps were very easy to apply on the press on nails that I bought. I am very pleased with my purchase. I definitely recommend purchasing these nail wraps. I would have given it five stars if they were all space patterns.

reviews.t: so that was an awesome surprise. Will update review after she uses them
reviews.x: My daughter has not seen these yet, as they're for her birthday, but she loves the galaxy print, so I don't really see how they can go wrong. I didn't realize I was getting three whole packages, so that was an awesome surprise. Will update review after she uses them.  I received this product in exchange for an honest, unbiased review. However, I would not have purchased had I not had faith in the product first. You DO get what you pay for, but I don't mind discounts! :)

reviews.t: They smelt really horrible. Like a strong plastic chemical smell
reviews.x: They smelt really horrible. Like a strong plastic chemical smell. Not like nail polish just really bad. I could still smell it on my nails a few days later. A little hard to put on. They didn't stick very well. It said you could use a top coat so I did and they all pretty much peeled off 4 days later. I prepped my nails using acetone, filed and made sure no cuticles were on the nail bed. It's a shame because I really liked the prints. Prob would not buy again.

reviews.t: very happy with the product and feel it is a good ...
reviews.x: These are really cute! I bought them for my 13-year-old daughter. She applied them herself. She added a coat of clear nail polish but they still began chipping after a few days. But she admitted she needs more practice applying them. Overall, very happy with the product and feel it is a good price. The design is really cool and my daughter liked that it came with a solid color so she could do a mixed mani.

I bought these because my nails were damaged after removing the gel polish, and I don't have time to polish my nails everyday. They were so easy to place and remove. I love these I want to order every color and style. I use to get the gel nails done only because, I didn't have to wait for it to dry and I hate chipped nails. This works just as well in less time without the damage.  Love it

reviews.t: ... tried out the grey set and it was really nice. It lasted a good amount of days before ...
reviews.x: I tried out the grey set and it was really nice. It lasted a good amount of days before it started chipping. I can't give it 5 stars because I hurt my finger and I put a bandage over it and when I took the bandage off, the nail wrap came off with it. Other than that, I look forward to using the other 2 sets this came with!

Happy with how easy these wraps are to apply. I want some other designs and if you all want ideas for some would love to discuss some design ideas. I love the simple grey color in this pack and can't wait to try the other ones included. The wraps are awesome and the colors are bold unlike other wraps. I'm a happy camper.

I have only used the solid grey set so far. But it has been great. Applying was easy and so far they are having no trouble staying on. I added a decal and gem for extra flare and a top coat for a little extra protection. The other decals look very clear and crisp in their design. I'm looking forward to wearing them.

reviews.t: I just opened them up to see what each set looks like. Really cool
reviews.x: These came on time and we'll packaged. Brand new. I just opened them up to see what each set looks like. Really cool. I can't comment on the length of wear or ease of use yet, waiting for my last decals from a different brand to come off. But I can't wait. Love the space look.

Easy to apply. They peeled off a little easily, but I'm a fidgeter so, if you don't mess with them they're probably great. Really nice designs, except the ones that are just gray. They aren't a wonderful gray, just a bit drab. I like them well enough though.

Love the nail wraps:) very easy to put on and sticks right to the nail. Decent price. Will purchase more in the future because I have small children, a budget and these nails take less then 15 minutes and look like I had them professionally done.

I would give these zero stars if I could.  I spent lots of time applying these and loved the look.  They started peeling within the first hour of wearing them and then some of the wraps started to completely come off thereafter.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently describe the wraps as very easy to apply.
Many praise the beautiful galaxy designs and colors.
The stretchable material helps achieve a good fit and avoid wrinkles.
Several reviewers report the wraps did not last long or peeled quickly.
Some note waste or difficulty fitting due to short nails and one-sided application.
